name: German as a Foreign Language B1 - Communikation in Companies
description:
The module is based on level B1 of the GER. In this module, students will acquire a skill level of German as a Foreign language that will enable them to communicate in a coherent and understandable manner in basic professional contexts 

Case studies are used to simulate professional situations such as writing e-mails, making phone calls, giving presentations, organizing or conducting meetings. What makes this course unique is that two TUM startups participate in the course, and students work on a real-world scenario developed in collaboration with the startups as part of their final exam assignment. 
Students acquire job-related vocabulary, idioms and phrases and learn to apply meeting related discourse patterns such as specifying advantages and disadvantages, making suggestions, offering solutions and contradicting.
Students practice team skills through cooperative interaction in multinational mixed groups.
prerequisites: Solid knowledge of level B1.1; Placement test with result B1.2
